changelog:
v1.3.0 — Fix emoji on Android 16 (OxygenOS)
• Root cause found: font_fallback.xml (the real font config) references NotoColorEmoji.ttf, not AppleColorEmoji.ttf
• Apple emoji now ships as NotoColorEmoji.ttf — overlays the stock COLRv0 Noto via magic-mount
• No APEX emoji on this device; overlay works directly
• Removed arm64-only restriction (fonts are arch-independent)
• fonts.xml awk simplified — emoji injection removed (no longer needed)
